name: Fighter Battleforged Soldier
body:
Not all battleforged soldiers are built to be shock troopers like the juggernauts. Some simply enhance themselves and their built-in weapons.

Requirement: A battleforged soldier must be a battleforged.

Bonus Battleforged Feat

Beginning with 1st level, anytime a battleforged soldier would gain a bonus fighter feat, they may choose any feat with the prerequisite of being a battleforged. This ability modifies bonus feats but does not preclude any other replaces bonus feats.

Battle Hardened (Ex)

At 2nd level, a battleforged soldier is always prepared for combat. They add their bravery bonus to initiative checks. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 2nd level.

Body as a Weapon (Ex)

At 5th level, anytime a battleforged soldier gains weapon training, they add it to all of their natural weapons, armor spikes, or any weapon attached to them via a battleforged weapon attachment. This ability replaces weapon training but does not preclude the battleforged soldier from taking advanced weapon trainings so long as they work with the weapons outlined in this ability.
